data.body: [P2] Prune acknowledged IDs even when the watermark does not advance. Older persisted executions load missing sequence fields as zero and can retain `UpdatedOperationIds`. Since `_begin_invocation` no longer clears those IDs, a valid checkpoint-free response acknowledging sequence zero skips this filtering. Subsequent invocations redeliver already-observed terminal operations, duplicating plugin callbacks and spans. Move the filtering outside the strict watermark-increase condition and add an old-format persisted-store regression.
